entries.4e3d0f9cd345995c: It has formulated the medium-term management plan “NEXT 2030” (covering the fiscal years from the year ended March 2026 to the year ending March 2031) and has set “a company gentle on the stomach” as its Purpose. Its 4 key strategies are: strengthening the foundation of the Sugar Business, strengthening the Bio Business centered on oligosaccharides, strengthening new businesses targeting “Food × Bio” as their target area, and rebuilding brand and sales strategies.
entries.55c2460a25ccde3b: Cyclodextrin is a cyclic oligosaccharide. Production started at the Osaka plant in 1983.
entries.5a654a1dd377b9e0: A business that manufactures and sells sugar. Manufacturing is carried out by commissioning processing from affiliates Taiheiyo Seito Co., Ltd., Kansai Seito Co., Ltd. and Narumiya Co., Ltd., and sales are mainly handled by consolidated subsidiary Pearl Ace Co., Ltd. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥31,296 million.

entries.755d77a1957d22db: Sugar consumption has been declining year by year due to the rise of high-intensity sweeteners and population decline, and the company positions itself as an independent sugar refiner fulfilling its responsibility for stable supply. Revenue from external customers in the Sugar Business for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥31,296 million, and it is expanding collaboration with peer companies, including an alliance with Fuji Nippon Co., Ltd. and a business alliance with Daito Seito Co., Ltd.
entries.75e106cda457626b: The group consists of Ensuiko Sugar Refining Co., Ltd., 2 consolidated subsidiaries (Pearl Ace Co., Ltd. and Pearl Foods Co., Ltd.) and 4 affiliates. Its head office is located in Nihonbashi, Chuo-ku, Tokyo, and consolidated employees as of March 31, 2026 were 83.

entries.926696eca1187424: Through its joint production arrangement with peer companies at Taiheiyo Seito and Kansai Seito, it maintains a structure for production efficiency and stable supply while remaining independent. In the Bio Business, it has the “Oligo no Okage” series, which has a track record of obtaining Foods for Specified Health Uses labeling approval in 1995, and the “Pearl Ace Mark” brand, supported by a business history spanning 120 years.
entries.9c115d6563ac5639: Sugar products are manufactured by outsourcing processing to the affiliates Taiheiyo Seito Co., Ltd. and Kansai Seito Co., Ltd., and to Narumiya Co., Ltd. Lactose-fructose oligosaccharides and cyclodextrin, which are bio products, are manufactured by outsourcing processing to Kansai Seito Co., Ltd.
entries.c8920a313e10b621: Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥32,982 million, up 1.4% year on year. By segment, revenue from external customers was ¥31,296 million for the Sugar Business, ¥1,562 million for the Bio Business, and ¥123 million for Other.
entries.ccd397ec7f5f4646: This business model purchases raw sugar, outsources processing to affiliates such as Taiheiyo Seito and Kansai Seito to produce refined sugar, and sells it to customers through its consolidated subsidiary Pearl Ace.
entries.dab675247c65c70f: A business that manufactures and sells sugar.
entries.dfc324e11f0c81f9: As an independent sugar refiner, rather than integrated production at its own plants, it has built its supply structure on processing outsourced to affiliates and on joint production and alliances with peer companies, and it concentrates sales at its consolidated subsidiary Pearl Ace. The structure is to stabilize the foundation of the Sugar Business while developing the Bio Business as a 2nd pillar.
